CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.native_employee_roster_projection_batch_v1(p jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(contract_id uuid, data jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 ctx jsonb; ten uuid; binding uuid; company bigint;
 civil_day date := (statement_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Mendoza')::date;
BEGIN
 ctx:=public.native_employee_context_v1(p);
 ten:=(ctx->>'tenantId')::uuid; binding:=(ctx->>'sourceBindingId')::uuid; company:=(ctx->>'sourceCompanyId')::bigint;
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH contracts AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT c.id,c.person_id,c.legacy_legajo,c.legacy_company_id,c.status,c.start_date,c.end_date,
          c.source_payload->'native' AS meta
   FROM public.employment_contract c
   WHERE c.tenant_id=ten AND c.legacy_company_id=company AND c.source_system='MUNICONTROL' AND c.source_batch_id IS NULL
   ORDER BY c.id FOR SHARE OF c
 ), identities AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT i.id FROM public.person_identity i JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c.person_id FROM contracts c) who ON who.person_id=i.id
   ORDER BY i.id FOR SHARE OF i
 ), targets AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT c.*,i.id AS identity_id,n.id AS reg_id
   FROM contracts c LEFT JOIN identities i ON i.id=c.person_id
   LEFT JOIN public.native_employee_registration n ON n.contract_id=c.id AND n.person_id=c.person_id AND n.tenant_id=ten AND n.source_binding_id=binding
 ), approved_lifecycle AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT DISTINCT h.contract_id FROM public.native_employment_lifecycle_review h
   WHERE h.tenant_id=ten AND h.source_binding_id=binding AND h.decision='approve'
 ), classification AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT t.*, (
    t.identity_id IS NOT NULL AND t.reg_id IS NOT NULL AND t.meta->>'registrationId'=t.reg_id::text
    AND (t.meta ? 'adoptionProposalId' OR t.meta ? 'adoptionReviewId')
    AND a.registration_id=t.reg_id AND d.id IS NOT NULL AND r.id IS NOT NULL
    AND t.meta->>'adoptionProposalId'=r.id::text AND t.meta->>'adoptionReviewId'=d.id::text
    AND a.before_contract->>'person_id'=t.person_id::text AND a.before_contract->>'legacy_legajo'=t.legacy_legajo
    AND a.before_contract->>'legacy_company_id'=t.legacy_company_id::text
    AND hist.contract_id IS NULL
   ) AS plain_adoption
   FROM targets t
   LEFT JOIN public.employment_adoption_application a ON a.contract_id=t.id
   LEFT JOIN public.employment_adoption_decision d ON d.id=a.decision_id AND d.decision='approve'
     AND d.tenant_id=ten AND d.source_binding_id=binding
   LEFT JOIN public.employment_adoption_proposal r ON r.id=d.proposal_id AND r.tenant_id=ten AND r.source_binding_id=binding
   LEFT JOIN approved_lifecycle hist ON hist.contract_id=t.id
 ), projected AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT t.id,
    CASE WHEN t.plain_adoption IS TRUE THEN jsonb_build_object(
      'startDate',to_char(t.start_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'endDate',to_char(t.end_date,'YYYY-MM-DD'),
      'status',CASE WHEN t.status<>'active' THEN t.status WHEN t.start_date IS NULL THEN 'unknown'
                    WHEN t.start_date>civil_day THEN 'pending_start' WHEN t.end_date<civil_day THEN 'inactive' ELSE 'active' END,
      'recordKind','adopted')
    -- Do not generalize absence, missing origin, a hire, or even a single
    -- approved historical lifecycle event: use the original full scalar. It
    -- preserves canonical errors and the full interval/today semantics.
    ELSE public.native_employee_read_projection_v1(p,t.id)->'contract' END AS value
   FROM classification t
 )
 SELECT x.id,jsonb_build_object('startDate',x.value->'startDate','endDate',x.value->'endDate',
   'status',x.value->'status','recordKind',x.value->'recordKind') FROM projected x;
END $function$
